channel.title: Fire Engineering Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Fire Engineering Magazine (fireengineering.com)

item.title: Apply by March 6 for Emergency Drinking Water for Wildland Firefighters
item.description: The application period is now open for the 2026 Anheuser-Busch Emergency Drinking Water for Wildland Firefighters Program, which provides critical hydration support to volunteer fire departments preparing for wildfire response and extended emergency operations.

item.title: Man Found Dead After Fire Inside NC Townhouse
item.description: A man was found dead in a Cary townhouse after firefighters responded to a small fire. The cause of the fire is under investigation.

item.title: Fire Damages Popular CT Pizza Spot
item.description: East Haven firefighters extinguished a fire at DePalma’s Apizza, limiting damage to a rear prep room. The cause is under investigation, with no injuries reported.

item.title: New Station, Strike Teams Bolster Firefighting Efforts in MS County
item.description: The Lee County Fire Strike Team began operations in January to enhance fire protection in north Lee County, supplementing volunteer departments and improving response times.

item.title: CT Reverses Course on Single-Stairwell Apartments Amid Fire Concerns
item.description: Connecticut lawmakers rejected a change to the building code that would allow smaller apartment buildings with a single stairwell, citing safety concerns from fire officials.

item.title: NY Pushes Battery Tech to Boost the Power Grid. Neighbors and Towns Fret Over Fire Risk
item.description: Upstate New York is seeing a surge in proposals for battery energy storage systems (BESS) as part of a clean energy initiative, but local leaders are concerned about safety after fire incidents.

item.title: Two Rescued After Hot Air Balloon Snags 900 Feet Up on TX Radio Tower
item.description: Two balloonists were rescued after their hot air balloon became tangled in a radio tower in Longview. No serious injuries were reported, and the FAA is investigating the incident.

item.title: New Details Emerge on Fatal NY Fire; Mayor Pledges to Go After Apartment Complex Owners
item.description: Syracuse officials are pursuing legal action against Nob Hill Apartments' owners after a deadly fire highlighted ongoing safety violations, including nonfunctional safety lights and lack of sprinklers.

item.title: Who Made the Call to Leave the Lachman Fire? In Sworn Testimony, LAFD Officials Pass the Buck
item.description: Testimony from Los Angeles firefighters reveals concerns about handling hot spots at the Lachman fire, raising questions about decision-making and oversight by LAFD officials before the deadly Palisades fire.

item.title: RECEO-VS: Not Just for Structural Firefighting
item.description: RECEO-VS is a time-tested acronym for assessing priorities while fighting structure fires. Christopher Pierce on how officers can apply this thinking to putting out administrative fires, as well.
